subject: [DISCUSS] Extracting escalation path from Gen-AI to apply in general

messages.subject: [DISCUSS] Extracting escalation path from Gen-AI to apply in general
messages.body:
Hello everyone,

We already agreed on the escalation path for when we see annoying Gen-AI
contributions. We even tested it in practice: PMC already blocked a user at
the ASF organisation level. After a while, they apologised, explained what
happened and promised to do better so we restored the user via ASF INFRA..

However, that incident was a footnote in a Gen-AI section of a PR. I think
it's a good idea to generalize this process, extract it to a separate page
and link to it from various places in our contributing documentation:

Here is the proposal:

https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/67557

I do not expect much controversy here—since we already agreed on this for
Gen-AI and tested it—but I wanted to discuss it here. If we get enough +1s
(with possible comments), I will call for LAZY CONSENSUS and merge it.


J.

messages.subject: Re: [DISCUSS] Extracting escalation path from Gen-AI to apply in general
messages.body:
+1 from me.

This appears to be a formalization of what already happens so there is no
controversy here.

Thanks,
Sameer Mesiah.
